title: SEEL: Towards End-to-End 3D Sign Generation with Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.33588v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: 3D sign language generation aims to produce signing motion from written text. Motivated by the linguistic nature of sign language, recent methods combine a motion tokenizer with a language model to predict motion tokens from text. However, both components are optimized through a two-stage pipeline with mismatched objectives: the tokenizer minimizes reconstruction error in isolation, while the generator learns from rigid one-hot reference tokens. A straightforward end-to-end extension bridges discrete token selection with straight-through estimators (STE), suffering from biased gradients and codebook collapse. To address these limitations, we propose SEEL, an end-to-end framework that aligns tokenization and generation with motion quality through two complementary mechanisms. translated_title: SEEL：基于语言模型的端到端3D手语生成
translated_abstract: 3D手语生成旨在从书面文本生成手语动作。受手语的语言学特性启发，最近的方法将动作分词器与语言模型相结合，从文本预测动作标记。然而，这两个组件通过两阶段流水线进行优化，目标相互不匹配：分词器单独最小化重建误差，而生成器从刚性的独热参考标记中学习。一种直接的端到端扩展方式通过直通估计器（STE）来桥接离散标记选择，但会遭受梯度偏差和码本崩溃的问题。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了SEEL，一个端到端框架，通过两个互补机制将分词与生成同动作质量对齐。首先，为了克服刚性独热监督，重建感知生成在上下文中解码候选标记，并将其3D动作误差转换为软目标……
tldr: 提出SEEL端到端框架，通过重建感知生成等机制将动作分词与语言模型生成过程和3D动作质量对齐，解决了以往两阶段流水线目标不匹配及直通估计器梯度偏差、码本崩溃的问题，实现更高质量的3D手语动作生成。
en_tdlr: SEEL is an end-to-end framework that aligns motion tokenization and language-model-based generation with 3D motion quality, overcoming the mismatched objectives, biased gradients, and codebook collapse of prior two-stage pipelines for 3D sign language generation.
